    Representation-finiteness through retracts #

    Let R : Mod S ⥤ Mod T be an additive functor between module categories of finite-dimensional algebras that sends finite modules to finite modules. If every finite indecomposable T-module is a retract of R L for a finite S-module L, then T is representation-finite when S is: each such module is isomorphic to an indecomposable summand of one of the finitely many modules R (B i), where the B i represent the indecomposable S-modules (Krull–Schmidt). This is the counting step of the cleaving lemma (Gabriel–Roiter 13.8).
